So if someone has switched a monitor to the wrong input and the person at the switch isn't paying attention they could easily patch over programing to the wrong feed.

A monitor at our station was switched to the second input (incoming source, not outgoing feed) so everyone glancing at that screen thought everything was okay.

Long story short: This can so easily happen with the press of a switch and can sometimes take a few moments for someone to figure out what happened and correct it.
